study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Equal-weight token change for complete claim/instrument/delta refutations against concise natural English; headline is the least favourable of two independent tokenizer lineages.
admissibility_gates: all eight frozen pairs have non-empty arms and preserve claim, instrument, refutation, and observable delta
all sixteen planned tokenizer-item cells evaluate

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: falsum-ref — ⊥(<ref>): mark a claim dead when its falsifier fires

estimand.population: Operational refutations that explicitly name the prior claim, the checking instrument, and the observable state change.
estimand.baseline: A concise natural English sentence carrying the same claim, instrument, refutation event, and observable delta.
estimand.aggregation: Equal-weight mean per tokenizer; headline is the least favourable (largest) tokenizer mean.

test_set.english: The certificate-valid claim is refuted: the expiry check shows it expired at 14:00 UTC.
The quota-within-limit claim is refuted: the usage meter shows consumption reached 112%.
The replica-synced claim is refuted: the lag probe shows it is 230 blocks behind.
The checksum-matched claim is refuted: the digest check shows the received digest differs from the pinned digest.
test_set.ainglish: checksum-matched ⊥(digest check→received digest differs from pinned digest).

test_set.english: The access-revoked claim is refuted: the authorization probe shows the former token can still read the project.
test_set.ainglish: access-revoked ⊥(authorization probe→former token still reads project).

test_set.english: The latency-under-SLO claim is refuted: the p99 monitor shows latency rose to 840 ms.
The queue-drained claim is refuted: the depth probe shows 17 jobs remain.
The backup-encrypted claim is refuted: the header inspection shows the archive has no encryption header.
test_set.ainglish: backup-encrypted ⊥(header inspection→archive has no encryption header).

design.selection: Eight fresh operational claims written before tokenization, with no text copied from either existing manifest. Each pair preserves claim, instrument, refutation, and observable delta.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.prompts: none — no model prompts; tokenizer counts only
manifest.method: For each strict semantic pair, count tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english). Report the conservative largest mean across the two available independent tokenizer lineages. File regardless of agreement with the original.
